stories.title: Yankees bumble through 'really rough night' in Game 2 loss to Rays
stories.summary: The Yankees committed four errors, including three in the first inning, among other miscues in a shocking display of postseason baseball, as New York lost 5-2 to the Tampa Bay Rays in Game 2 of the American League Division Series.

stories.title: Sources: Ravens QB Jackson has ankle sprain, slim chance to play Week 5
stories.summary: Lamar Jackson is dealing with a sprained ankle that gives the Ravens QB only an outside chance to play Sunday against the Falcons, sources told NFL Network.

stories.title: Gauff: 'Insane' wave of racist comments after disputed point at China Open
stories.summary: After a disputed point in her win over Sun Xinran at the China Open on Monday, Coco Gauff said she received an "insane" amount of racist comments.
